P = practice(); lab2i = {l:i for i,l in enumerate(LABELS)}
y = np.array([lab2i[p['label']] for p in P])[:1024]
m = np.load('pass_2/mean_hidden_L9.npy').astype(np.float64); x = np.load('pass_2/cls_hidden_L9.npy').astype(np.float64)
LN = lambda X: (X-X.mean(1,keepdims=True))/X.std(1,keepdims=True)
def cv_acc(X, y, lam, reps=4, std=True):
    n,d = X.shape; accs=[]
    for r in range(reps):
        perm = np.random.default_rng(r).permutation(n); folds = np.array_split(perm, 5)
        c=0
        for f in folds:
            tr = np.setdiff1d(np.arange(n), f)
            mu = X[tr].mean(0); sd = X[tr].std(0)+1e-6 if std else np.ones(d)
            Xt = (X[tr]-mu)/sd; Xv = (X[f]-mu)/sd
            Y = np.eye(8)[y[tr]]
            Wt = np.linalg.solve(Xt.T@Xt + lam*np.eye(d), Xt.T@(Y-Y.mean(0)))
            c += ((Xv@Wt).argmax(1)==y[f]).sum()
        accs.append(c/n)
    return round(np.mean(accs),4)
def pcs(X): 
    Xb = X.mean(0); U,S,Vt = np.linalg.svd(X-Xb, full_matrices=False); return Xb, Vt
mb, Vm = pcs(m); xb, Vx = pcs(x)
print('ref mean9 nostd', [cv_acc(m,y,l,std=False) for l in [3,10,30]])
print('ref concat full nostd', [cv_acc(np.concatenate([m,x],1),y,l,std=False) for l in [3,10,30]])
for k1,k2 in [(384,384),(512,256)]:
    for c2 in [1,2]:
        F = np.concatenate([(m-mb)@Vm[:k1].T, c2*(x-xb)@Vx[:k2].T],1)
        F = LN(F)  # stand-in for LayerNorm of the routed vector
        print(k1,k2,c2,'std',[cv_acc(F,y,l) for l in [200,400]], 'nostd', [cv_acc(F,y,l,std=False) for l in [1,3,10]])
